title: netdust-flow project pack
description: `.flow/pack.yaml` — what a project's pack needs bound, and which tools its gates shell out to. Validated by bin/flow-arm.py at arm time; a pack that does not validate refuses the arm rather than surfacing as a BLOCKED walk later.

binds.description: Every {placeholder} this pack's flows use. A bind with a `value` is supplied by the pack itself; one without is expected from the project CLAUDE.md or --bind, and its `description` becomes the hint when it is missing.

requires.description: Tools the pack's gates shell out to. A missing one refuses the arm; `optional: true` downgrades it to a warning.
